articles.title: Rare Orange ‘Pumpkin Spice’ Baby Loggerhead Turtle Spotted in Florida
articles.summary: A Florida beachgoer photographed a rare orange-toned loggerhead hatchling nicknamed ‘pumpkin spice’ as it headed to the sea.

articles.title: First DARCYS Awards Honor Disability Stories in Film and TV
articles.summary: The inaugural DARCYS awards celebrated disability representation, with honors for projects including The Pitt and Take Me Home.

articles.title: Wimbledon Boss Jokes Military Guards Would ‘Sort Out’ Disruptive Influencers
articles.summary: Wimbledon’s CEO says influencers will be closely managed and jokes that military security would stop mid-match content shoots.
